description: table.place scenario (.tbps.json) — UNSTABLE, generated from the live types, no compatibility promise. See docs/packs.md and llms.txt.

state.description: overrides + anything not pack-derived (ad-hoc pieces, hand-placed cards)
state.title: state

packs.description: v2: packs this scenario draws content from

items.description: Enough to re-resolve a pack's content at load time.

source.description:
`'builtin'` (shipped with the app), `'local'` (this browser's pack
library) or a URL a `.tbpp.json` can be fetched from. Omitted refs are
looked up in the builtin registry, then the local library.
source.title: source

packs.title: packs

items.description:
Where one piece of pack content goes. `content` is the deck `slot` (decks)
or the array index (pieces/overlays) within the referenced pack — the
`<pack>/<slot>` half of the `<pack>/<slot>/<code>` addressing in docs/packs.md.

seat.description: placeholder seat that owns the spawned entity; omitted for table-scoped overlays
seat.title: seat

order.description:
decks only — the authored card order as pack card `code`s. A scenario is a
saved arrangement, so a stacked deck round-trips exactly. Ids only, never
card bodies: referencing the pack is the whole point of v2.
order.title: order

shuffleOnLoad.description:
decks only — reshuffle on load instead of restoring `order`. Per placement,
so one scenario can hold a fixed encounter deck and a shuffled draw deck.
shuffleOnLoad.title: shuffleOnLoad

state.description:
piece placements only — which of the pack piece's `states` it starts on
(index into `PackPieceDef.states`, default 0). Distinct from the
scenario's top-level `state` snapshot: this is one piece's face.
state.title: state

snapPoints.description:
Placement guides for whatever ends up on the table, pack-derived or not —
and the only place a file should author them. Additive: a scenario without
them behaves exactly as it did before they existed, and they don't decide
the file version (a hand-placed table with snap points is still v1).

items.description:
An authored placement guide: a spot on the felt that a dropped card or piece
finishes exactly on. Scenario-level and table-space — a snap point belongs
to the board, not to a seat, so it is not mirrored per seat the way pack
piece positions are.

Deliberately shaped like TTS's save-level `SnapPoints` (position + optional
rotation) so importing those stays a mechanical mapping.

position.description: table-space `[x, z]`; no y — snap points live on the felt
position.title: position

rotation.description:
Yaw a caught drop turns to, in **degrees**. Omitted leaves the entity's
own rotation alone. Degrees, not the radians `placements` use, because
this is a single table yaw and it maps 1:1 onto both the card DTO's tap
rotation and TTS's snap-point rotation.
rotation.title: rotation

radius.description: catch radius in world units; omitted means the app default (0.9)
radius.title: radius

snapPoints.title: snapPoints

$schema.description: optional editor-validation hint; always written on export
$schema.title: $schema

specVersion.description:
Semver of the scenario spec this document was authored against. Always
written on export; optional on read so files predating spec versioning
still validate and still import. 0.x — see `SCENARIO_SPEC_VERSION`.
specVersion.title: specVersion

snapPoints.description: authored placement guides, keyed `snap:<n>`. null = remove
snapPoints.title: snapPoints

isFaceUp.description: true if the deck is face up (like discard pile)
isFaceUp.title: isFaceUp

cards.description: Cards in deck are an array instead of record
cards.title: cards

Provenance stamped on pack-spawned entities so a scenario export (tbps v2)
can reference the pack instead of inlining its content. Wire-safe: the
relay server merges state schema-agnostically.

content.description: content id within the pack: deck slot, or piece/overlay index
content.title: content

source.description: where the pack re-resolves from: 'builtin' or a fetchable URL
source.title: source

packOrigin.title: packOrigin

shuffleOnLoad.description: scenario authoring intent (tbps v2): reshuffle this deck on scenario load
shuffleOnLoad.title: shuffleOnLoad

shuffledAt.description:
wall-clock ms of the last shuffle. Its only job is to CHANGE in the same
patch as the reordered cards — the reorder alone is invisible from the
back, the changed timestamp is what remote clients turn into the wiggle.
shuffledAt.title: shuffledAt

connected.description:
server-owned presence: merged into the lobby state on socket
connect/disconnect. Absent until the server has said anything —
treat undefined as offline-unknown, never as connected.
connected.title: connected

metadata.description: extend for future use with life/resources
metadata.title: metadata

Provenance stamped on pack-spawned entities so a scenario export (tbps v2)
can reference the pack instead of inlining its content. Wire-safe: the

kind.description:
Non-card table objects (tokens, pawns, counters, dice). One generic shape
with a kind discriminator — see SPEC.md §4a.
kind.title: kind

color.description: hex tint; pawns/counters without images render in this color
color.title: color

imageUrl.description: token top-face image ref (resolved like card faces)
imageUrl.title: imageUrl

states.description:
Faces this piece can be cycled through, `states[0]` being the base face.
Carried on the entity (not looked up from the pack) so a client that
never loaded the pack still renders whatever state the table is in.

items.description: One alternate face of a multi-state piece — see `PackPieceStateDef`.

face.description: face ref, resolved like a card face
face.title: face

states.title: states

state.description: index into `states`; absent = 0. Synced like every other mutation.
state.title: state

radius.description: world radius of the piece footprint
radius.title: radius

value.description: counter state — also the up-face of a die (1…sides)
value.title: value

sides.description: dice only: how many faces the die has
sides.title: sides

rollSeq.description:
dice only: bumped once per roll. The roll itself is sent as
`{value, rollSeq}` in one patch — never a stream of frames — and every
client plays the tumble locally when this number changes, settling on
`value`. It is therefore both the animation trigger and the dedupe
nonce: a client that has never seen this die seeds its last-seen seq on
first sync, so joining after a roll shows the settled face with no replay.
rollSeq.title: rollSeq

contents.description:
bags only — the hidden pool a draw pulls from, in insertion order (lifo
takes the last entry, fifo the first). Lives in synced state so a draw
resolves once, on the acting client, and every client agrees on the result.
No UI ever renders it.
contents.title: contents

drawMode.description: bags only — draw order; treated as `'random'` when absent
drawMode.title: drawMode

infinite.description: bags only — draws clone instead of removing (TTS Infinite_Bag)
infinite.title: infinite

packOrigin.description:
Provenance stamped on pack-spawned entities so a scenario export (tbps v2)
can reference the pack instead of inlining its content. Wire-safe: the
relay server merges state schema-agnostically.

content.description: content id within the pack: deck slot, or piece/overlay index
content.title: content

source.description: where the pack re-resolves from: 'builtin' or a fetchable URL
source.title: source

packOrigin.title: packOrigin

anyOf.description: A piece waiting inside a bag — no position: the draw decides where it lands.
A card waiting inside a bag; `code` becomes part of the drawn card's id.

position.description:
Table-space `[x, z]`. No y: a snap point is a spot on the felt, and what
lands on it keeps its own resting height (a card on a card still stacks).
position.title: position

rotation.description:
Yaw the landing snaps to, in **degrees**, or omitted to keep whatever
rotation the entity already had. Degrees to match the card DTO's tap
rotation (`actions/card.ts`) and TTS's `SnapPoints`.
rotation.title: rotation

radius.description: catch radius in world units; omitted means `SNAP_RADIUS_DEFAULT`
radius.title: radius
